title: OMCS configuration
description: Version-one OMCS policy configuration. Credentials, provider settings, model-account choices, tokens, and command paths are not valid configuration fields.

profile.description: Execution profile. Model or provider selections are not configuration fields.

approvals.description: When OMCS asks for approval of a material action.

antiSlop.description: Whether OMCS runs its anti-slop quality gate.

visibleProgress.description: Whether OMCS reports visible progress during orchestration.
